text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: U-um, Fuji? I was hoping I could get your advice on my dancing…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I would be glad to help you, my darling pony! I'll make sure you don't regret asking me for help. That's a promise.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: O-oh! Fuji!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I always mess up in the same spot when it's time for the real deal… I don't know what to do!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Then just listen closely to my voice so you can stay on track. You can do that, can't you, lovely pony?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: O-oh my gosh! Yes! I could listen to your voice all day long!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki is the epitome of reliability. She's always calm and collected, and many students look up to her. As a trainer, I should try to be more like her.
choice_data_list: Time to train now, dearest ponies…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Saying that out loud is so much more embarrassing than I thought it would be… I can't possibly do it. I'd probably scare everyone away instead.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hm, were you pretending to be me just now?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Just now. But what a wonderful surprise! That was a very good impression of me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, I've just had a great idea! Since we have tomorrow off, why don't we spend it together? There's a game I want to play with you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The next morning, I hurry to our meeting spot, intending to arrive first, but Fuji Kiseki is already waiting for me by the time I get there.
choice_data_list: S-sorry for making you wait, sweet pony.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: It's fine. I wasn't here long. Are you all right? I suppose you couldn't help but sprint over as soon as you caught sight of my visage. It's okay, take your time to catch your breath.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The "game" she wants to play with me is for us to imitate each other all day long.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She says focusing on reactions and attitude, rather than tone, will give us a chance to understand each other better.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: All right, let's go. Tell me if you get tired, okay?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: That was incredible! You got an even higher score than before! I wish I could see you do that again!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I won't even blink, so just relax and do your best!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You've sung quite a bit. Are you thirsty? Should we order some drinks?
choice_data_list: Y-your voice is as beautiful as a canary's… It'd be lovely, er…
Y-your voice is as beautiful as a canary's… It'd be lovely, er…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You mean you'd like to hear more? Sure! But let's take it easy for now. We still have a lot of time. There's no rush.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We've kept at the game for the entire day, but for some reason, Fuji Kiseki's interpretation of me seems so…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Are you tired? We did walk a lot today. Shall we call it here?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her version of me seems like a thoughtful, well-put-together adult who knows all their partner's good points and praises them accordingly.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. So, what did you think of today's game? Did you enjoy it?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it was a lot of fun.
I think we could've done better.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm not sure if I did a good job imitating her, but spending all day thinking about how she usually acts or responds to things was interesting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It makes me feel like I've gained a deeper understanding of her, and I tell her so.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, so you were thinking about me all day long, were you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. That makes me happy. I'm glad we were able to have such a good time together. And now, I must ask…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Do you finally understand the way I see you, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki's question catches me so off guard that I can do no more than stare at her while she gives me a wicked smile.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, really?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hm, you might have a point. The version of you in my mind is much more wonderful than the way I portrayed you today!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe. As for the way you see me… Let's just say I don't hate it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'd like to get to know each other even more so we can imitate each other better next time…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What do you think we should do to make that happen, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki pins me down with an amused smile, and I really have no idea how I should answer her.
